summary: Correction to the Sep 27 FanDuel easy-props settlement: De'Von Achane left in the first quarter with a knee injury and did not return. FanDuel's automatically applied September Bet Protect+ removed that eligible leg. Ayomanor and Knox both won, so the repriced two-leg ticket won rather than losing.

parlays.title: 3-leg easy props at FanDuel
parlays.why: Easy props, for fun: 3 legs at FanDuel, one per game, each an easier line our projection clears comfortably. A quarter unit, tracked with the longshots, apart from the straight picks.
parlays.risk: Every leg has to hit; one miss sinks the ticket. Our player chances are tuned for main lines, so these legs are not value, just fun. A player who does not take the field voids his leg under the book's rule.
parlays.settlementReason: Achane's protected rushing-yards leg was removed after his first-quarter injury. The two live legs both won, and their captured -166 and -205 prices reprice the ticket to +138.
